description:
List PostgreSQL extensions that can be loaded with `CREATE EXTENSION` in this service.

Returns `extensions`: an array of `{ name, default_version, versions }`, where `versions` is an array of installable version strings.


This tool may return a long list; results support filtering and pagination to narrow large catalogs.

limit.description: Max items to return. Do NOT set this unless the user explicitly asked for a specific number of results.

offset.description: Number of items to skip for pagination. Use the value from the `next_offset` field in a previous response to fetch the next page.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring filter. Matches against `name`. Only items containing this string are returned.

name: aiven_pg_service_available_extensions
title: Service Available Extensions
